An epsilon-covering of [delta,1]^n is a finite set of parameter vectors such that every beta is within KL divergence epsilon of some center.

Crude quadratic upper bound on mutual information: I(pi;Z) <= (k*p*n*(n-1)/2)*D(1/(1+delta)||delta/(1+delta)).
With probability at least 1-1/n^5, the maximum skill parameter is within 5*log(n)/(b*n) of 1.
